files.why: The parser must accept `tagged_union <type> <field>[:<field>]*`. TaggedUnion must check that each tag field has the same position and width in every block, forbid mixing with class-mask tags, and use the OR of the tag-field masks as the tag mask. It must also read the tag with one combined function, emit enum values as plain unshifted numbers, and skip field functions (especially `set`) for tag fields.
